PROVENANCE: [measured_local_harness] 42/42 tests | [vendor_published_spec_as_of_2026] 15 URLs | [synthetic_scenario_model] Separated n=92 vs n=19
Fabric Workspace Private Link + Managed VNet Spark + OAP + TWA vs. 4 Clouds
Zero-Trust Inbound Isolation & Default-Deny Outbound Exfiltration Defense ($0 NAT/Firewall Tax) vs. VNet Injection & Snowflake Business Critical (1.5x)
1. Zero-Trust Perimeter Architecture: Legacy VNet/Firewall Tax vs. Fabric Managed VNet + OAP
❌ Pain Point A/B: Custom VNet Injection NetOps Tax & Snowflake Business Critical 1.5x Tier Tax
• Classic VNet Injection: Requires customer-managed /22 subnets, NAT Gateways, & Azure Firewall ($8K+/mo)
• Open Outbound Spark Egress: Malicious PyPI wheels or rogue notebooks can POST data to external IPs
• Edition Gatekeeping: Snowflake requires upgrading to Business Critical (~1.5x credit cost) just for PrivateLink
• Modeled 22-Workspace Sovereign NetSec TCO [synthetic_scenario_model]: $27,600/mo (+$18,900/mo penalty)
• Storage Firewall Dilemma: Opening ADLS Gen2 public access just so cross-workspace analytics can read tables
✅ Fabric Workspace Private Link + Managed VNet + OAP + MPE + Trusted Workspace Access
• Workspace-Level Private Link: Per-workspace inbound isolation on standard F-SKUs (0 public endpoints)
• Outbound Access Protection (OAP): Default-deny all Spark/Notebook egress; block rogue PyPI POST (0 bytes leaked)
• Managed Private Endpoints (MPE): Admin-approved PrivateLink tunnels to Azure SQL, Snowflake, & ADLS Gen2
• Trusted Workspace Access (TWA): Resource-instance backbone bypass into firewall-locked ADLS Gen2 vaults
• Modeled 22-Workspace Sovereign NetSec TCO [synthetic_scenario_model]: $8,700/mo (-68.5% / Save $18,900/mo)
• Better Together: Use Databricks Classic VNet Injection for custom L7 DPI appliances + Fabric Private Link for BI/Agents
